content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form compiler interface artifact for dispersionfluxessources, generated from moment_gpu.f90. It enumerates CUDA, cuSPARSE, cuTENSOR, reduction, sorting, global/parameter, and boundary-condition dependencies; host/device work arrays; derivative, dispersion-step, flux, HLL, reconstruction, wave-speed, wavemaker, and source-term GPU procedure interfaces; and opaque compiler symbol, argument, expression, cross-reference, and type records (lines 1-2199).
entities: dispersionfluxessources compiler-interface artifact generated from moment_gpu.f90 (lines 1-2)

Public and private dependencies including cusparse, param, global, mod_cuda, iso_c_binding, nvf_acc_common, cuda_runtime_api, cutensor, nvf_reductions, nvf_sort, cudafor_la, and boundary_condition_module (lines 4-18)
Host and device dispersion work arrays including du_d, dv_d, dut_d, dvt_d, omega, and d1in_d through d7in_d (lines 46-562)
Derivative kernel interfaces derivative_x_kernel, derivative_y_kernel, derivative_xx_kernel, derivative_yy_kernel, and derivative_xy_kernel (lines 571-608)
Dispersion stage kernels cal_dispersion_step1_kernel through cal_dispersion_step6_kernel, including step1p5 (lines 610-759)
Flux procedures fluxes_gpu, flux_at_interface_gpu, flux_at_interface_hll_gpu, and hll_kernel (lines 760-797)
Difference and wave-speed interfaces delyfun_kernel, delxfun_kernel, delxyfun_gpu, wave_speed_kernel, and wave_speed_gpu (lines 798-843)
Reconstruction interfaces construction_gpu, construction_ho_gpu, construct_x/y kernels, and higher-order x/y stage kernels (lines 844-974)

Wavemaker/source-term interfaces and their physical/control inputs such as grid bounds, minimum depth, gamma1/gamma2, wavemaker geometry, period/frequency, time ramp, viscosity/breakwater/sponge switches, and source arrays (lines 975-1175)
Compiler attribute, expression, cross-reference, argument, and type records (lines 1176-2199)
unresolved: The V35/0x24 compiler module format and the meanings of its D/S/R/A/F/J/V/T/X/Z numeric records, flags, offsets, and bit masks are not defined within the artifact, so most numeric metadata cannot be decoded from the file alone (lines 1, 19-2199).
The timestamp 06/12/2026 does not state whether its date order is month/day or day/month (line 3).
The compiled interface exposes the spelling n_suth alongside n_nrth, n_west, and n_east, but the artifact does not establish whether n_suth is intentional or a misspelling of n_south (lines 675-678).
